applicabilityBasis.summary: bC3M is a tokenized tracker certificate and debt security referencing the Amundi ETF GOVIES 0-6 Months EUROMTS Investment Grade UCITS ETF. Its price follows underlying EUR-denominated government-bill ETF value rather than an issuer commitment to redeem for a fixed euro amount. Issuer documentation describes bTokens as tokenized securities/debt instruments; GENIUS section 2(22)(B)(iii) excludes securities from the payment-stablecoin definition.

genius.licensingRegulator: Swiss DLT Act registered uncertificated securities framework
genius.notes: Security exclusion is supported by the exact tracker-certificate product rights and issuer debt-instrument disclosure. US-person restrictions are a separate distribution fact, not the basis of the security exclusion. New bToken issuance is closed; standard redemption remains supported during the end-2026 wind-down. Swiss DLT issuance structure does not change the Jersey issuer domicile or confer GENIUS PPSI authorization. Reserve disclosure denotes public underlying-collateral/product disclosure; the retired live dashboard is not treated as current quantitative reserve evidence. Automated Chainlink/Network Firm PoR does not establish a monthly independent accountant attestation. No named U.S. regulator enforcement action was found in exact-issuer official-domain searches on 2026-10-07. NAV-based redemption remains available to eligible holders. It does not establish a fixed 1:1 national-currency redemption policy, so redemptionPolicyPresent is false under the tracker field definition.
